body: Just a quick note to say that PGXN Manager has been updated with more secure password storage. Existing passwords are unmodified, but the next time you change your password, it will be upgraded to a more robust password hashing algorithm that’s more resistant to attacks. I recommend everyone update their passwords. If you have a PGXN Manager account, just hit password reset, enter your username or email address, and check your mail for a reset link. Once you update your password, it will be stored in the new, more secure format.
